{{Top|leg|italics=1}}
'''''Leap''''' is a [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda''-class T-4a shuttle]] that was used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. The shuttle was onboard the [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|frigate]] [[Dodger (EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate)|''Dodger'']] and was used by Rebel [[Officer/Legends|officers]].

==Behind the scenes==
'''Leap''' appears in the [[Combat chamber]] [[Alpha-class Xg-1 Star Wing/Legends|Assault Gunboat]] mission 4. The shuttle was to be launched if the ship was at 50% Hull condition and is to be destroyed as part of a "Bonus" objective.
